'''Torrin''' was the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] and of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]]. His siblings were [[Erra]] and [[Rondar]], and was the uncle of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Winera]]. After the Empire had set up its blockade around [[Daimar]], King Mitar sent Torrin's niece, Winera, [[Alet Komain]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shen-Ji Collun]] to the planet [[Byrsym]] (where Torrin had an anti-Imperial resistance group) for their protection. Torrin received them safely and protected them there, while his brother Rondar and his father remained at Daimar.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
